scenarios.title: Tablet landscape: collapsed rail shows only primary destinations, expands to all
scenarios.why: 7143a965: wide windows use WideNavigationRailCollapsed with primary=false on Team/Wiki/Open-closed sprints; expand/collapse button with content-descriptions; revisit 45 (clipped rail).
preconditions: Tablet AVD, landscape (1280x800dp), logged in as admin at http://10.0.2.2:9000, main-project selected

steps.do: Open the Dashboard on the tablet in landscape.
steps.expect: A navigation rail is shown on the left in collapsed form (icons, no modal drawer), with a ≡ button at the top (content-desc 'Expand navigation'). Team, Wiki and sprint-list entries are NOT in the collapsed rail; Dashboard, Epics, Issues, Kanban and Settings are.

The rail expands with labels and now also lists Team (and Wiki / Open sprints / Closed sprints where the project has them). Settings/log-out entry is fully visible, not clipped. Button now reads 'Collapse navigation'.
Team screen opens; Team is highlighted as selected.
Rail returns to the collapsed icon-only form.

steps.do: Look at the top bar of the Team screen.
steps.expect: No hamburger/menu icon in the top bar (the rail replaces it).

checks.name: rail-content-descriptions-logcat-free
checks.verifies: No FATAL EXCEPTION lines in logcat during expand/collapse and navigation to Team.

scenarios.title: Phone landscape and portrait keep the modal drawer, not a rail/bottom bar
scenarios.why: 7143a965: useModalDrawer when width <600dp OR height <480dp; previously a phone in landscape (wide, short) got a rail/bottom bar with up to 12 items.
preconditions: Phone AVD Pixel_10a, logged in as admin, main-project selected

steps.do: On the phone in portrait, open Dashboard.
steps.expect: Top bar has a hamburger icon; no rail or bottom bar. Tapping the hamburger opens a modal drawer with all destinations.
Still the hamburger + modal drawer; no navigation rail or bottom navigation bar appears.

steps.do: Open the drawer in landscape and tap 'Issues'.
steps.expect: Drawer closes and the Issues list opens as a single pane (no two-pane split).

scenarios.title: Tablet landscape: Issues shows list and detail side by side
scenarios.why: 86cabbbc / 7143a965: list-detail scene strategy re-enabled for Issues (listPane / detailPane) on wide windows.
preconditions: Tablet AVD landscape, logged in as admin, main-project has issues #3 'Issue 23vv' and #16

steps.expect: Issues list is shown; the right pane shows an empty/placeholder detail area (two panes visible).
Detail of #3 appears in the right pane while the list stays visible on the left; list row for #3 stays visible.

steps.do: Tap issue #16 in the left list.
steps.expect: The right pane switches to #16's details; the list is still shown.
Layout collapses to one pane showing the currently opened issue detail (no crash); back goes to the list.
Two panes are shown again with no crash.

checks.name: issue-detail-requests
checks.verifies: After opening #3 then #16, logcat shows exactly one detail fetch per opened issue (no duplicate refetch loop) and no 'failed with exception'.

checks.name: no-crash
checks.verifies: No FATAL EXCEPTION / 'Missed recording an endGroup' lines after the whole sequence.

scenarios.title: Two-pane: pushing User Story from issue detail does not crash (old step 12c bug)
scenarios.why: 86cabbbc/UserStoryNavGraph: UserStoryDetails pushed from the detail pane previously crashed with 'Missed recording an endGroup'; two-pane max for Issues.
preconditions: Tablet landscape, admin; issue #3 'Issue 23vv' is already promoted to user story #18

steps.expect: Two panes: list left, issue #3 detail right; detail shows a link/section for the promoted user story #18.

steps.do: In the detail pane, tap the user story #18 link.
steps.expect: User story #18 details open without the app crashing; the screen still has at most two panes (issues list stays on the left or the story replaces the detail on the right).
Returns to issue #3 detail in the right pane with the list on the left; no crash.

checks.name: no-compose-crash
checks.verifies: Logcat has no FATAL EXCEPTION or 'Missed recording an endGroup' after the push and back.

scenarios.title: Each pane shows its own top bar actions, also after back navigation (old step 12c app-bar bug)
scenarios.why: 77709c87: each list-detail pane draws its own top bar (PaneTopBars) so the list's '+' no longer overwrites the detail's '⋮' after back.
preconditions: Tablet landscape, admin; issue #3 and user story #18 exist

steps.expect: The list pane has its own top bar with '+' (create issue); the detail pane has its own top bar with '⋮' (more) and a title for the issue. There is no single global top bar over both.

steps.do: Tap the user story #18 link in the detail pane, then press Back.
steps.expect: After returning, the list pane still shows '+' and the detail pane shows '⋮' (the old bug showed '+' in place of '⋮').
The issue's overflow menu opens (e.g. edit/delete options).

steps.do: Dismiss the menu, tap '+' in the list pane.
steps.expect: Create Issue screen opens.
Issues two-pane again with '+' and '⋮' both present.

scenarios.title: Single-pane screens on tablet keep one top bar; no hamburger; back arrow works
scenarios.why: MainScreen: top bar hidden only while panes draw their own; withoutMenuIcon on wide windows.

steps.expect: Normal single top bar with title and its actions, no hamburger icon.

steps.do: Open Issues, tap #16, then rotate to portrait.
steps.expect: Single pane issue detail with exactly one top bar (back arrow, '⋮'), not two stacked bars.
Issues list shows with its top bar and '+'.

steps.do: On the phone AVD, open Issues, tap #16.
steps.expect: Single pane detail with one top bar and back arrow; Back returns to the list with '+'.
